summary: Phase 4 Slice E (chat router dual-write Mongo + Supabase Postgres) verified GREEN end-to-end. Backend pytest: 28/28 PASS in test_iteration14_phase4e_chat_dualwrite.py. Direct asyncpg + motor probes confirm: (1) POST /api/chat/messages (admin->cg AND cg->admin) writes rows to BOTH Mongo chat_dms and Postgres chat_dms with matching id/from_id/to_id/text/read=false and from_id=ADMIN_UUID, to_id=CAREGIVER_UUID exactly; (2) GET /api/chat/threads returns at least the caregiver thread with last_message='TEST_SliceE thread cg reply', unread>=1, role='caregiver', and 'photo_base64' key present (value may be null) — all data sourced from the single Postgres CTE; (3) GET /api/chat/messages?with=<cg_id> returns the full DM chain in chronological order (created_at ascending) AND the mark-as-read is mirrored to BOTH stores: post-call PG count where to=admin AND from=cg AND read=false drops to 0, and Mongo count with the same filter also = 0; (4) GET /api/chat/threads immediately after the conversation read shows unread=0 for that thread; (5) GET /api/chat/contacts as admin returns 12 caregivers, every record has id/email/name/role='caregiver', no admins leak; demo caregiver UUID is present; (6) GET /api/chat/contacts as caregiver returns >=1 admin, every record has role='admin' (no caregivers); admin UUID is present; (7) Validation preserved: POST /api/chat/messages with empty/whitespace text -> 400, non-existent recipient_id -> 404; (8) POST /api/assistant/chat over real Claude SSE: the response streamed [DONE], and immediately after, the PG chat_messages table contains exactly one role='user' AND one role='assistant' row for that session_id+admin_id pair, with the same pair also present in Mongo chat_messages (1+1 count); (9) GET /api/assistant/history/{session_id} returns ['user','assistant'] in chronological order; the history endpoint is correctly scoped to the calling user_id — admin GETting a sid whose rows belong to the caregiver returns [], whereas caregiver GETting the same sid returns the 1 row. Slice A/B/C/D regression GREEN under BOTH legacy HS256 (Admin@123) and Supabase ES256 (AdminPassword123!) JWTs: /auth/me, /stats (total_clients=1, total_caregivers=12, total_documents=50), /caregivers, /clients (list + detail), /assignments, /documents, /shifts — all 200 + expected shapes. Final parity: PG chat_dms == Mongo chat_dms (2 == 2), PG chat_messages == Mongo chat_messages (24 == 24) — exact match, back to documented baseline after cleanup. Frontend regression (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): login in Supabase mode lands on Dashboard (1 Clients / 12 Caregivers / 50 Documents / 0 Trainings; Audit Readiness 50%). Open Chat -> threads list renders 'Sarah Johnson' with the latest message preview; opening the thread renders the chronological message history (sender bubble vs receiver bubble visible); sending a new DM via the chat-input/chat-send testIDs immediately appends the new bubble to the thread and the row is also confirmed live in both Mongo + PG. Schedule tab loads with 'No shifts scheduled' card + Day/Week toggles + 'New shift' button visible. No expo/react-native deprecation or red-screen issues introduced by Slice E. The /chat/threads SQL CTE is materially faster than the prior Mongo aggregate + per-thread photo fetch (single SQL round-trip).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:362-367 — /chat/messages reads from Postgres but mark-as-read writes are not atomic across stores. The Mongo update_many runs first, then supa_data.mark_dm_read(); if Mongo succeeds and PG fails the read-marker drifts. supa_data.mark_dm_read uses _safe() which swallows the error. Since Slice E is best-effort dual-write this is intentional, but Slice J should make PG authoritative or wrap both in a try/except with a reconciler.

server.py:1540-1550 — assistant_msg persistence happens INSIDE the SSE event_gen generator. If the client disconnects mid-stream the consumer cancels the generator before the final await db.chat_messages.insert_one(assistant_msg) executes; the user_msg WILL be persisted but the assistant reply will be lost from BOTH Mongo and PG. Consider wrapping the persist in a finally / asyncio.shield so partial responses are still saved.

supa_data.py:704-746 — list_dm_threads runs a single CTE that joins profiles for photo_base64 and role. This is materially faster than the prior approach. One concern: if a partner is in chat_dms but not in profiles (e.g., a deleted user), the LEFT JOIN still returns the row but with photo_base64=null and role=null, which the response then surfaces as role=null. Frontend should handle role==null gracefully (currently the Chat list shows 'Sarah Johnson' fine because the partner exists, but a tombstone partner would render with no role badge).

supa_data.py:688-701 — insert_dm uses 'on conflict (id) do update set read=excluded.read' which is safe for re-runs but means the only mutable field via this path is `read`. If a future API ever needs to edit DM text, a separate update helper is required (not a bug today, just a foot-gun).

supa_data.py:779-789 — insert_chat_message has on conflict do nothing; the SSE handler writes user_msg + assistant_msg with distinct uuids generated server-side, so collisions only happen on retry. Safe.

server.py:351-355 — /chat/threads no longer consults Mongo at all (pure PG read). If PG is briefly unreachable the endpoint will 500. Consider a Mongo fallback in supa_data.list_dm_threads, or surface a clearer error.

Cleanup hygiene: two orphan DMs from a previous smoke run remained in BOTH Mongo and PG when I started (texts 'Slice E hello from admin' / 'reply from caregiver' dated today). They were in sync across stores — so the dual-write itself isn't leaking; the issue is the smoke script's cleanup runs only when the script finishes normally. Consider adding a try/finally in scripts/_smoke_slice_e.py so an assertion failure mid-run still cleans up.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Slice E is GREEN. All chat endpoints are dual-write: writes go to Mongo first then Postgres (best-effort via _safe wrapper). READS are entirely from Postgres for /chat/threads (single CTE joining profiles for photo_base64+role), /chat/messages?with= (chronological), /chat/contacts (sourced from profiles where role='caregiver' or 'admin'), and /assistant/history/{sid} (scoped by session_id+user_id). The /chat/messages mark-as-read is mirrored to BOTH stores. /assistant/chat streams Claude Sonnet 4.5 SSE; user_msg is persisted before the stream starts, assistant_msg after the stream completes — both dual-written. Reusable fixtures in test_iteration14_phase4e_chat_dualwrite.py: legacy_admin_token, supabase_admin_token, legacy_caregiver_token, HA/HCG/HSUPA header fixtures; pg_fetchrow/pg_fetchval/pg_fetch/pg_execute and mongo_count/mongo_delete sync helpers with event-loop-safe runner. Frontend testIDs verified: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, open-chat-button, thread-<uuid>, chat-input, chat-send. Next slice (per smoke-test layout in /app/scripts/) is presumably Slice F (onboarding or policy_acks) or Slice J (Mongo decommission).
